item.title: Tecnologo: BRIDGeconomies – Business Relays for Innovation and Development Growing Economies, PRJ-2074 (Univ. PALERMO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-20 12:00
Institution: Univ. PALERMO, Palermo
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IINF-03 Telecomunicazioni

A selection procedure based on qualifications and examinations is hereby launched at the University of Palermo to fill 3 Technologist posts on a fixed-term basis (24 months, or in any case until the project end date of 31 December 2028), of which 1 full-time and 2 part-time (18 hours per week), salary grade EP1, to be assigned to the Research and Innovation Area for activities related to the project BRIDGeconomies – Business Relays for Innovation and Development Growing Economies.
